articles.title: Crypto PAC pours $362K into California race voters essentially decided in August
articles.snippet: A Fairshake affiliate is supporting incumbent Aisha Wahab through ads in November, but the congresswoman already won a special election in the district.

articles.title: Crypto Super PAC Fairshake Pours Millions More Into Defeating Sherrod Brown
articles.snippet: An FEC filing shows the Fairshake affiliate Defend American Jobs disclosed roughly $7 million more in ads against the Ohio Democrat, pushing its total past $46 million—days after the PAC expanded its map to 32 House races.
